status.description:
Status of the connector request.
Status Final Description
APPLIED Yes The changes have been successfully applied to the connector.
FAILED Yes The changes failed to process or apply to the connector./td>
PENDING No The connector's changes are awaiting approval and processing.
REJECTED Yes The connector's changes were rejected. Check the reason for details.

reason.description: The reason for the unapproved status

submittedAt.description: Date and time the connector changes were submitted, specified in ISO 8601 format.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Date and time the connector was last updated, specified in ISO 8601 format.
